_comment: The playground's model services: the ONE file to edit to add one. Each entry: id (unique), label, type (stt | tts), url (the base of an OpenAI-compatible API, up to /v1), models, and for tts voices. api is openai (the default: STT on POST {url}/audio/transcriptions, TTS on POST {url}/audio/speech) or mimo (Xiaomi MiMo: TTS on POST {url}/chat/completions, the text as an assistant message, audio {format, voice}). auth, for a service that needs a key: the header that carries it, an optional prefix ("Bearer "), and the file the key is read from on every request, a Secret mounted by deployment.yaml; the key never leaves the server. A service whose key file is missing or empty is listed as unavailable. The cluster bricks are named by their short Service names (http://stt, http://tts): in production, Services of type ExternalName point them at namespace speech (speech-services.yaml); in a preview, they are the bricks running beside the playground. Adding another OpenAI-compatible service needs only this file, its url the full cluster name of its Service if it is in namespace speech; an external one also needs its host in networkpolicy.yaml, and its key a Secret mounted in deployment.yaml.
